ITEM 1 | Golden-brown waffle quarters with a grid pattern of square pockets, slightly crisp edges, dry matte surface, two to three pieces spanning roughly 12 cm across the right-center of the plate, about 2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Orange-yellow cubes of roasted sweet potato, about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with browned caramelized edges and a soft interior, scattered in the lower-left area of the plate | 80
ITEM 3 | Pale, opaque white soft mounds with a creamy, slightly glossy surface, holding a rounded shape, about 4 to 5 cm across, sitting on top of the waffle and sweet potato on the left | 60
ITEM 4 | Scrambled egg-like crumbles, yellow with green flecks and light browning, loosely clumped and crumbly, covering about 6 by 5 cm at the top-center of the plate | 50
ITEM 5 | Round browned sausage slices, about 2.5 cm in diameter and 1 cm thick, glossy reddish-brown with slightly charred edges and firm texture, arranged in a loose line along the right side of the plate | 90
ITEM 6 | Dark brown roasted potato or root pieces, irregular chunks about 2 cm, with crisp browned surfaces and a dense interior, clustered near the bottom center beside the waffle | 40
